applicableAreas: Southern property boundary along OHE utility line
Western property boundary along Valley View Road E utility line
findings.comment: Landscape plan proposes Cedar Elm (typical mature height 50-70 feet) and Live Oak (typical mature height 40-50+ feet) trees within 25 feet of overhead electric distribution lines shown as -OHE- and -E- on the plan. Large trees (40+ feet mature height) are prohibited within 25 lateral feet of distribution conductors; no clearance dimensions, measurements, or variances are documented.

applicableAreas: Landscape Plan areas near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) does not identify tree species at planting locations. While Sheet 35 provides a plant schedule listing species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Texas Mountain Laurel, Mexican Redbud), the landscape plan itself shows only generic tree symbols (SY, PL, M designations) without species identification. Trees near overhead electric facilities must be identified by species on the landscape plan to verify utility compatibility and clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Landscape Plan areas near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Landscape Plan does not differentiate large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) from smaller trees. All proposed trees near overhead electric infrastructure use the same symbol categories (SY, PL, M) without notation of mature height or large tree designation. Large trees near electric facilities must be clearly identified to verify compliance with 25-foot clearance requirements for distribution and 50-foot clearance for transmission.

applicableAreas: Entire property; southern and western boundaries
findings.comment: While Landscape Plan shows both proposed trees and overhead electric utility lines (-OHE- on southern boundary, -E- on western boundary), the relationship between trees and conductors is not clearly documented. No dimension lines, clearance callouts, notes, or cross-references indicate how trees comply with required clearances from overhead conductors and poles. Tree clearance compliance cannot be verified from the landscape plan as presented.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary along OHE utility line
Western property boundary along Valley View Road
findings.comment: Trees are shown on the landscape plan in proximity to overhead electric distribution lines on both the southern and western boundaries. No documented written approval from Austin Energy authorizing tree placement in restricted clearance zones is visible on the submitted plans. UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires explicit written approval from Austin Energy for variations to tree planting standards near electric facilities.
